sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At the heart of Ragdoll Gangs is its core gameplay mechanics. The game's use of ragdoll physics makes for a visually appealing and humorous experience, with characters bouncing around the screen in a delightfully cartoonish manner. The gameplay is simple yet addictive, with players controlling their characters as they fight against CPU-controlled opponents in the Arena Mode, or navigate through six levels in the Adventure Mode.

         In terms of controls, the game is easy to pick up and play. The default controls are W A S D for movement, C to pick up characters, Throw to throw characters, Activate to activate special moves, P for punch, V for kick, and B for run on the left side, and I, O, P, R-shift to punch, kick, run and lock/ unlock cursor on the right side. The controls are simple and intuitive, making it easy for new players to jump in and start playing right away.

         One of the standout features of Ragdoll Gangs is its use of special moves. By activating characters in the right situations, players can unleash devastating special moves that can turn the tide of battle in their favor. These special moves are easy to unlock and can be used to great effect in both Arena Mode and Adventure Mode.
